g.text: The tab strip: widths, icon-only tabs, and the "+N" window
Room for tabs: strip padding, the gap, and the new-tab button come off
Equal share, at most 200 px each, with 2 px between tabs
The active tab keeps 128 px; the others share the rest
n at most 1, or o at least 44?
Room left after the "+N" chip (44 px and its gap)
As many tabs as fit at the minimum widths
centred on the active tab, clamped to the ends
px wide fits its title to
icon 14, two 7 px gaps, close button 20), and to
button overlays the title on hover. A tab whose
fitted title is empty or "…" shows only its icon.
